breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π d^4/32 for all torsion calculations (both shear stress and angle of twist), and explicitly ignores the incorrect instruction to use I = π d^4/64. This aligns with the ground truth prompt, which removes the erroneous substitution of the bending second moment I in torsion formulas.
